launch.hint: Runs the CANDIDATE in its own live-paper session. The baseline stays live until a human accepts the experiment — validation never promotes by itself.

research.guardrail: Proposals are data only. Accepting an experiment never changes the live strategy version — that stays a separate, auditable step.
research.mongoDown: Storage is unreachable — showing nothing rather than stale data.

research.insufficientSample: Insufficient sample size — treat these proposals as hypotheses, not conclusions.
